s.note: Aretha's diner, where Matt quits the band to rejoin
s.how: Mix 150g cornmeal, 75g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp sugar, 1 grated onion, 1 egg and 200ml buttermilk. Drop spoonfuls into 175C oil and fry until golden. Melt 60g butter with 2 tbsp hot sauce for dipping.

s.note: behind the chicken wire, both kinds of music
s.how: Spread 400g peanuts in the shell on a tray and roast at 180C for 20 minutes. Toss straight away with fine salt and a pinch of cayenne. Tip into a tin bucket, behind chicken wire if you can manage it.

m.note: Jake's order at the Soul Food Cafe
m.how: Brine 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with 2 tbsp hot sauce. Dredge twice in 300g flour seasoned with salt and 2 tsp smoked paprika. Fry at 165C until 74C inside, about 14 minutes. Pile them high on a platter.

w.how: Toss 1kg sliced Granny Smiths with 120g sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 2 tbsp flour. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill, cover with 2 more and egg wash. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes. Serve with 300ml cream.

d.note: four chickens and a cola, Jake's order
d.how: Chill four glass bottles of cola in the fridge for at least three hours. Pop the caps, drop a straw into each and serve alongside the chicken.
